headline: Get Squarrel
title: How to Get Squarrel | The Fire Breaker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Squarrel is a Fire Breaker that lives in Blitzwood. Its Pinecone Bomb throws a flaming pinecone that marks enemies, and Heavy Tail Strike eats the mark for extra damage and a stun. Its Raging Fire trait makes the basic attack after a skill hit much harder. At level forty seven it evolves into Squashel. Is Squarrel on your team? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Squarrel is a Fire Breaker found in Blitzwood. Pinecone Bomb marks enemies, Heavy Tail Strike consumes the mark, and at level 47 it evolves into Squashel.
